got.answer: You can skip one SIP instalment at a time through the "What can I do next?" page: open the SIP, choose Edit SIP, then select Skip Installment. Groww's help states that you can request to skip another instalment for the same SIP once the first skipped instalment date has passed. If three consecutive instalments are skipped, the SIP is cancelled automatically. A skip request does not apply if the next instalment is due within two days; in that case it applies to the instalments after it. Your SIP's latest instalment, due 5 Nov 2026, is still in progress, with its units not yet confirmed as allotted. Note that the July 2026 instalment was already skipped. Groww support can confirm how these rules apply to your next instalment.
